The 'New game' button in the top right is overly prominent with a bright gold color, drawing more attention than the board itself.

Consolidate the turn indicator: move the 'White to move' status to the top 'Turn' panel and make it visually dominant (e.g., larger text or a colored indicator) to eliminate the split information. 4.
